glossary.property_company: Société civile immobilière CSL, owner of the château
glossary.operating_company: Future commercial company operating the guest house
glossary.shareholder_current_account: Interest-free associate advance recorded as a debt of the operating company
glossary.working_capital: Cash needed to cover launch stock, timing differences and routine operating payments

included_families: professional fees, launch equipment, working capital and contingency to identify
scope.quote_requirement: Every invoice must be classified as property-incorporated work, detachable operating asset, operating expense or working capital before the borrower and payer are selected.

shareholder_current_account_policy.accounting_treatment: Principal repayment is a cash outflow and balance-sheet movement, not an operating expense.
shareholder_current_account_policy.repayment_priority: Repay only when operating-company liquidity and bank covenants permit.
clauses_to_consider: no repayment while the operating company would become cash-negative
shareholder_current_account_policy.external_validation: Written agreement, corporate approval, accounting treatment and bank acceptability

A_operating_company_bank_loan.property_work_warning: If the operating company finances an asset incorporated into property owned by the SCI, a robust works, lease, indemnity and tax agreement is required before payment.
A_operating_company_bank_loan.reading: The consolidated total hides an operating-company deficit. The operating company cannot support the full 50,000 EUR loan in the reference case.

appropriate_for: networks and fitted assets incorporated into the château
B_property_company_bank_loan.operating_company_funding_role: Use the 10,000 EUR share capital and 20,000 EUR shareholder current account only for detachable furniture, operating equipment and working capital supported by invoices.
B_property_company_bank_loan.warning: The 12,000 EUR rent covers the modeled new SCI loan by only about 451 EUR before all existing SCI debt service and costs. A confidential consolidated debt review is mandatory.

funding_and_guarantee_leads: Initiative Vosges Centre Ouest interest-free personal honour loan, subject to committee approval and allocation compatible with the plan
Bpifrance or France Active bank guarantee, subject to borrower, lender and project eligibility
France Rural Revitalisation Zone tax or employer relief, subject to exact territorial, creation, tax-regime and employment conditions
2C2R and Vosges Department tourism property-investment aid, only if applicant, guest-house works, timing and expenditure thresholds are confirmed eligible in writing
decision_gates: invoice-by-invoice allocation between the SCI and operating company
confirmation of the guest-house five-room and fifteen-guest limits
updated municipal declaration, works, destination and insurance checks
two comparable bank offers including annual percentage rate, fees, insurance and security
confidential review of all existing SCI debt service and costs
written shareholder-current-account agreement and bank-approved repayment priority

confidential_financing_annex.repository_rule: Do not publish exact existing property-company debt, undisclosed historical shareholder-current-account balances, securities, guarantees or bank statements.
required_for_bank_review: remaining principal, rates, annual payments and maturity of existing property financing
undisclosed shareholder-current-account balances and repayment or subordination terms by entity
recent accounts, tax returns, cash statements and property valuation
confidential_financing_annex.storage: restricted confidential annex outside the public repository
